budget.initialization: original generic empty-hand preparation may move the arm; separately logged, not counted as a research action

additional_instances.appearance: same red material as original task cube

scene.boundary: setup names/poses are private generator data, never E0 or WorldHead inputs; add only for separate capture scene; no mid-episode repositioning or changes to original material/contact/control parameters
scene.lifecycle: capture-only setup after original initialization, before a fixed 120-step settling interval and one RGB-D capture; no subsequent path execution; this scene is NOT motion-qualified until original planner rebuild/registration is separately checked

public_output: one frozen public RGB-D/K/T/FK bundle after settling; no private scene names/poses/masks in E0 or WorldHead inputs
coverage_gate: two similar red rigid instances plus one distinct object, each with >=12 observable valid foreground-depth pixels in >=2 views; two red bboxes distinguishable in fixed image. Audit actual RGB/pixels after the single capture, no GT-derived boxes. If missing coverage, DATA_INSUFFICIENT, no rearrange/retry or call.
after_capture: close Owner; audit saved RGB only; no live scene while awaiting E0
motion_qualification: NOT_ESTABLISHED; added actors not registered for future planned motion; no motion allowed after setup
private_scoring: separate private final actor poses and hashes, never in model bundle
